I audited both [Nextwave](https://nextwave-template.webflow.io/home) and [Portx](https://portx.framer.ai/) top-to-bottom. Here are the **shared patterns & trends** they follow—and where they diverge from our current v1.0 [design.md](design.md):

### Shared Patterns in Nextwave & Portx vs. Our Current Plan

| Dimension | Nextwave + Portx Trend | Our Current v1.0 Plan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Display Typography** | **Monolithic ALL-CAPS geometric/grotesque sans** (`Funnel Sans` / `Clash Display`), ultra-tight tracking (`-0.03em`) and leading (`0.85–1.0`). Zero serifs. | `Instrument Serif` (editorial serif + italics) + `Inter` + `JetBrains Mono`. |
| **Color & Accents** | **Stark monochrome dark mode** (`#000000`–`#111111`, pure `#FFFFFF` text & pill CTAs, `#2E2E2E`–`#8A8A8A` grays). Either **no UI accent** (Nextwave) or **one surgical accent** (`#F83200` in Portx) so project art pops. | Obsidian `#0A0A0C`, warm alabaster `#F4F2ED`, and **dual accents** (`#D4FF00` lime + `#3B82F6` cobalt). |
| **Hero Structure** | Crisp top metadata/status bar (location, availability, years) → massive asymmetric ALL-CAPS headline + `#FFFFFF` pill CTA → **full-width visual showcase** directly beneath. | Generative canvas background with editorial headline. |
| **Interactive Disciplines Band** | Both feature an oversized stacked **Services/Disciplines switcher** (`BRANDING`, `UI/UX`, `ANIMATION`) where the active title lights up `#FFFFFF`, dimming siblings to `#2E2E2E`, and reveals live visual previews on hover. | Not included yet (only filter pills + Evolution timeline). |
| **Works Presentation** | Non-generic layouts: **sticky `01–04` progress rail** (Nextwave) or **staggered asymmetric grid** mixing wide/square/portrait ratios (Portx). | Standard bento/asymmetric grid. |
| **Signature Micro-Interactions** | **Dual-label rolling-text** hover inside `#FFFFFF` pill CTAs (`● CONTACT NOW`), `1px` animated hairline dividers, `↗` arrows, scroll-zooming showcase media, and animated stat counters. | Magnetic pull + custom cursor pill. |

---
